item.title: 🔴 SGLang RCE Exploit Breaches NEAR AI, Steals Data From 18 Agents and About 100 Users
item.description:
Why this matters: Potential data exposure — review monitoring and incident-response readiness.
An attacker exploited a remote code execution flaw in SGLang, an open-source inference engine, and ran code on one of NEAR AI's inference servers last Sunday. item.title: 🔴 Google Issues Chrome Security Update for Eighth Actively Exploited Zero-Day of 2026
item.description:
Why this matters: Potentially urgent issue — confirm whether your environment is exposed.
Google on Monday released updates to patch nine security vulnerabilities, including one that has come under active exploitation in the wild. The high-severity vulnerability, assigned the CVE identifier CVE-2026-125350 (CVSS score: N/A), has been described as a use-after-free bug in the XML component.
